Week 2026-W42: 4 releases, 1 needs action
Ollama 0.9 changes a default; Vitest 5 and Node 24.1 are worth a look.

elements.text: Ollama 0.9 changes a default; Vitest 5 and Node 24.1 are worth a look.

text.text:
*🔴 Act now*
• *<https://github.com/ollama/ollama/releases/tag/v0.9.0|Ollama 0.9>*: The default context window grows from 2k to 4k tokens.
→ Pin num_ctx in your Modelfiles before upgrading.

*🟡 Worth a look*
• *<https://vitest.dev/blog/vitest-5|Vitest 5.0>*: Browser mode is stable and the default runner is faster.
→ Teams testing UI components should try it.
• *<https://nodejs.org/en/blog/release/v24.1.0?ref=digest&utm=weekly|Node 24.1>*: Security fixes for the HTTP parser.
→ Everyone running Node 24 in production.

*⚪ Good to know*
• *<https://github.com/pnpm/pnpm/releases/tag/v10.34.0|pnpm 10.34>*: Fixes a lockfile race & clearer install logs.
